svg.text: Exploratory fold statistic: far-apart adjacent numbers summing to R
R (candidate sum of two numbers naming adjacent key letters)
Observed: blue; shuffle mean: dashed light grey; 99th percentile: solid dark grey
Adjacent pairs: |a-b| >= 100, |a+b-R| <= 1. Maximum-over-R shuffle p = 0.0005 (2,000 shuffles); exploratory.
